salmanshh_dhtn_manager.name: Utility-Driven HTN (Hierarchical Task Network) Manager
salmanshh_dhtn_manager.description: Build smarter enemy and NPC AI with utility-driven HTN planning, alert reactions, and squad coordination, plus scalable time-sliced performance in addition to powerful behavior trees. This plugin provides a flexible framework for creating complex, data-driven AI behaviors in your games.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Turn planner processing on or off. Use case: disable AI during pause menus.

debugMode.name: Debug mode
debugMode.desc: Show debug logs in the console. Use case: inspect why an agent picked a task.

planningMode.name: Planning mode
planningMode.desc: Choose how often planning runs. Start with Per frame for simple projects; switch to Interval when many agents are active to reduce CPU usage.

planningIntervalSec.name: Planning interval (sec)
planningIntervalSec.desc: Time between planning updates when Planning mode is Interval. Example: 0.2 means one planning pass every 0.2 seconds (5 times per second).

maxAgentsPerTick.name: Max agents per update
maxAgentsPerTick.desc: How many agents to evaluate each update; 0 means all. Use case: cap spikes in large crowds.

planningTimeSliceSec.name: Planning time slice (sec)
planningTimeSliceSec.desc: Maximum time allowed for planning work in one update. 0 disables this limit. Example: 0.002 gives planning about 2 ms per update to keep frames smooth.

interruptThreshold.name: Interrupt threshold
interruptThreshold.desc: Minimum utility score needed to interrupt a running task. Use case: reduce rapid plan swapping.

maxPlanDepth.name: Max plan depth
maxPlanDepth.desc: Stops very deep or looping plans. Use case: catch broken network JSON safely.

alertDecayRate.name: Alert decay rate
alertDecayRate.desc: Alert drop per second with no stimulus. Use case: enemies calm down over time.

alertTier1Threshold.name: Alert tier 1
alertTier1Threshold.desc: Level where agent becomes suspicious. Use case: tune early warning behavior.

alertTier2Threshold.name: Alert tier 2
alertTier2Threshold.desc: Level where agent becomes alerted. Use case: switch from patrol to search.

alertTier3Threshold.name: Alert tier 3
alertTier3Threshold.desc: Level where agent enters combat. Use case: delay full aggression until threat is clear.

AddAlertStimulus.display-text: Add {1} stimulus to agent {0} with intensity {2} at {3}, {4}
AddAlertStimulus.description: Adds a simple stimulus event. Use case: raise alert when a guard hears a noise.

AddAlertStimulusExtended.display-text: Add extended alert stimulus to agent {0} using {1}
AddAlertStimulusExtended.description: Adds a detailed stimulus from JSON. Use case: set custom decay and update world state in one call.

ClearStimuli.description: Removes current stored stimuli. Use case: reset sensory pressure after a scripted state change.

DecayAlert.description: Lowers alert by a fixed amount. Use case: calm an agent after the player escapes.

SetAlertLevel.display-text: Set alert level for agent {0} to {1}
SetAlertLevel.description: Sets alert level directly from 0 to 1. Use case: force combat mode when player is spotted.

AddCompoundTask.display-text: Add compound task {1} for agent type {0}
AddCompoundTask.description: Adds or ensures a compound task node in the current builder draft.

AddMethod.display-text: Add method {2} on task {1} for agent type {0}
AddMethod.description: Creates a method branch on a compound task.

methodId.name: Method ID
methodId.desc: Unique method id within that task.

AddMethodCondition.display-text: Add condition {3} {4} {5} to method {2} on task {1} for agent type {0}
AddMethodCondition.description: Adds one world-state condition gate to a method.

AddMethodSubtask.display-text: Add subtask {3} to method {2} on task {1} for agent type {0}
AddMethodSubtask.description: Adds one subtask to a method in execution order.

subtaskTaskName.name: Subtask Task Name
subtaskTaskName.desc: Task name referenced by this method.

AddPrimitiveTask.display-text: Add primitive task {1} with runtime id {2} for agent type {0}
AddPrimitiveTask.description: Adds a primitive task that resolves to one runtime task id.

primitiveId.name: Primitive ID
primitiveId.desc: Task id output by the planner.

AddUtilityInputLinear.display-text: Add utility input key {1} weight {2} invert {3} points ({4},{5}) to ({6},{7}) for scorer {0}
AddUtilityInputLinear.description: Adds one scorer input with a 2-point curve.

BeginTaskNetwork.display-text: Begin task-network draft for agent type {0} with root task {1}
BeginTaskNetwork.description: Starts a clean task-network draft for one agent type.

BeginUtilityScorer.display-text: Begin utility-scorer draft for scorer {0} with aggregation {1}

ClearTaskNetwork.display-text: Clear task-network draft for agent type {0}
ClearTaskNetwork.description: Removes the in-progress task-network draft for one agent type.

RegisterBuiltTaskNetwork.display-text: Register built task-network draft for agent type {0}
RegisterBuiltTaskNetwork.description: Finalizes and registers the current task-network draft.

RegisterBuiltUtilityScorer.display-text: Register built utility-scorer draft for scorer {0}
RegisterBuiltUtilityScorer.description: Finalizes and registers the current utility-scorer draft.

SetMethodUtilityScorer.display-text: Set scorer {3} for method {2} on task {1} for agent type {0}
SetMethodUtilityScorer.description: Links a utility scorer to one method branch.

AssignAgentToSquad.description: Puts one agent in a squad. Use case: build patrol teams at layout start.

AutoAssignNearestFreeSlot.list-name: Coordination: Auto Assign Nearest Free Slot
AutoAssignNearestFreeSlot.display-text: Auto assign nearest free {2} slot in squad {1} to agent {0} from {3}, {4} max {5} ttl {6}
AutoAssignNearestFreeSlot.description: Finds nearest free slot and reserves it. Use case: auto-pick closest cover for each squad member.

agentX.name: Agent X
agentX.desc: Agent world X used for distance.

agentY.name: Agent Y
agentY.desc: Agent world Y used for distance.

ClearSquadStateKey.description: Removes one shared squad key. Use case: clear temporary rally point after regroup.

InvalidateSquadPlans.description: Marks squad members stale for next planning update. Use case: tactic changed for full squad.

LoadSlotPositionsFromJson.list-name: Coordination: Load Slot Positions From JSON
LoadSlotPositionsFromJson.display-text: Load slot positions for squad {0} type {1} from {2}
LoadSlotPositionsFromJson.description: Loads many slot positions from JSON array data. Use case: import a pre-authored cover map.

LoadSlotPositionsFromWorldStateKey.list-name: Coordination: Load Slot Positions From World State Key
LoadSlotPositionsFromWorldStateKey.display-text: Load slot positions for squad {0} type {1} from {2} key {3} agent {4}
LoadSlotPositionsFromWorldStateKey.description: Loads slot positions from a world-state key. Use case: share dynamic slot maps through state data.

scope.name: Scope
scope.desc: Read from global state or an agent state.

key.name: Key
key.desc: State key containing JSON/array slot data.

ReleaseSlot.display-text: Release slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0}
ReleaseSlot.description: Releases a reserved slot. Use case: free cover slot when an agent moves away.

RemoveAgentFromSquad.description: Removes one agent from its squad. Use case: cleanup when an NPC is defeated.

RequestSquadPlans.description: Requests immediate planning for squad members. Use case: execute synced reaction now.

ReserveSlot.display-text: Reserve slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0} for agent {3} for {4} sec
ReserveSlot.description: Reserves a squad slot with TTL. Use case: allocate unique cover nodes to avoid overlap.

SetSlotPosition.display-text: Set slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0} to {3}, {4}
SetSlotPosition.description: Defines one slot position from event-sheet coordinates. Use case: set cover node positions at layout start.

SetSlotReservation.display-text: {0} slot {3} of type {2} in squad {1} for agent {4} ttl {5}
SetSlotReservation.description: Combined reserve/release slot action. Use case: simplify event sheets while keeping full slot control.

SetSquadLeader.description: Sets the leader agent for a squad. Use case: only leader chooses squad tactic.

SetSquadStateKey.description: Writes shared squad state. Use case: set tactic to flank_left for all members.

SquadPlanControl.description: Combined invalidate/request squad planning action. Use case: choose delayed or immediate squad replan with one ACE.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Invalidate for next update or request now.

DumpAgentState.description: Prints one agent snapshot in the console. Use case: quickly check world state and current plan.

SetDebugMode.description: Turns debug logging on or off. Use case: inspect planner decisions while testing.

ProcessPlanningNow.description: Runs one planning pass immediately. Use case: apply state changes now instead of waiting.

SetEnabled.description: Turns processing on or off. Use case: disable AI while game menus are open.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: True to process planning, false to skip updates.

SetMaxAgentsPerUpdate.list-name: Performance: Set Max Agents Per Update
SetMaxAgentsPerUpdate.display-text: Set max agents per update to {0}
SetMaxAgentsPerUpdate.description: Caps agents evaluated per update. Use case: smooth frame-time spikes with large NPC groups.

count.name: Count
count.desc: 0 means all agents; any other value is a per-update cap.

SetPlanningIntervalSec.description: Sets time between planning passes in seconds for Interval mode. Beginner tip: try 0.1 first, then raise to 0.2 or 0.25 if you need more performance.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.desc: Seconds between planning updates in interval mode.

SetPlanningMode.description: Switches how often planning runs. Beginner tip: use Per frame while learning, then switch to Interval if frame rate drops with many agents.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Per frame updates every tick; interval uses seconds.

SetPlanningTimeSliceSec.display-text: Set planning time slice to {0} seconds
SetPlanningTimeSliceSec.description: Sets max planning time allowed per update in seconds. Beginner tip: start at 0 (off), then try 0.001-0.003 if big AI spikes cause frame drops.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.desc: 0 disables time slicing; higher values allow more planning work each update.

ClearPlan.description: Removes remaining planned tasks. Use case: keep an agent idle until new orders arrive.

ForceTask.description: Forces one task to run first. Use case: trigger a scripted reaction during a cutscene.

InvalidatePlan.description: Marks a plan as outdated for next update. Use case: world changed but current task should finish.

PausePlanning.description: Stops planning updates for one agent. Use case: freeze NPC AI while a dialogue plays.

RequestPlan.description: Builds a fresh plan right now. Use case: replan instantly after a major event.

ResumePlanning.description: Restarts planning for one agent. Use case: resume AI after a stun or cutscene.

ClearWorldStateKey.description: Removes one world-state key from an agent. Use case: clear last known target after search ends.

RegisterTaskNetwork.description: Loads a task tree from JSON for one agent type. Use case: register guard AI at layout start.

agentType.name: Agent type
agentType.desc: Agent type string used to look up the network.

networkJson.name: Network JSON
networkJson.desc: HTN task network definition as JSON.

RegisterUtilityScorer.description: Loads a utility scoring rule from JSON. Use case: tune attack vs retreat behavior by data.

SetGlobalStateKey.description: Sets a value shared by all agents. Use case: toggle a global alarm state.

SetWorldStateKey.display-text: Set world state {1} for agent {0} to {2}
SetWorldStateKey.description: Sets one value for one agent. Use case: update health or target visibility each tick.

IsAgentInSquad.description: Checks current squad membership. Use case: run squad-only logic per agent.

IsSlotFree.display-text: Is slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0} free
IsSlotFree.description: Checks if a slot is available. Use case: only reserve cover if not already occupied.

IsSquadLeader.description: Checks leader status in current squad. Use case: leader-only tactic writes.

OnSlotReleased.description: Triggered when a slot is released or expires. Use case: make slot visible as available again.

OnSlotReserved.description: Triggered when a slot gets reserved. Use case: update debug overlays for cover claims.

OnSquadMembershipChanged.description: Triggered when an agent joins or leaves a squad. Use case: refresh squad HUD widgets.

OnSquadStateChanged.description: Triggered when shared squad key-values change. Use case: react when tactic flips.

HasWorldStateKey.description: True if a world-state key exists. Use case: guard logic when optional data may be missing.

IsAgentPaused.description: True when planning is paused for that agent. Use case: skip AI updates during scripted moments.

IsAgentPlanning.description: True when an agent has work to do. Use case: branch events when an NPC is currently busy.

IsAlertTier.description: Checks the current alert tier name. Use case: run different events for suspicious vs combat.

IsTaskNetworkRegistered.description: True when a task network is loaded for that type. Use case: verify setup before spawning agents.

IsUtilityScorerRegistered.description: True when a scorer ID is available. Use case: validate data packs before combat starts.

OnAlertStateChanged.description: Triggered when alert tier changes. Use case: change music or UI for suspicion/combat states.

OnPlanFailed.description: Triggered when no valid plan is found. Use case: force an idle or safe fallback action.

OnPlanInterrupted.description: Triggered when high-urgency input interrupts a plan. Use case: swap from patrol to combat immediately.

OnPrimitiveTaskStarted.description: Triggered when a primitive task begins. Use case: play movement or attack events for that task ID.

OnStimulusReceived.description: Triggered when any stimulus is added. Use case: spawn investigation markers at stimulus coordinates.

OnTaskCompleted.description: Triggered after task completion is reported. Use case: chain to the next animation state.

OnTaskFailed.description: Triggered when a task fails. Use case: run a fallback task or recovery behavior.

OnTaskNetworkRegistered.description: Triggered after a network loads. Use case: print setup success in debug events.

AgentSquad.description: Gets the squad ID for an agent. Use case: print squad tags in debug text.

AssignedSlotId.description: Gets assigned slot ID for an agent and slot type. Use case: drive movement to assigned cover node.

CountSquadAgents.description: Counts members in a squad. Use case: detect when reinforcements are needed.

CountSquads.description: Counts active squads. Use case: monitor coordination load.

GetSquadAgentUIDByIndex.description: Gets squad member UID at index. Use case: iterate members in a repeat loop.

SlotOwner.description: Gets owner UID of a slot. Use case: verify which agent owns a cover slot.

SquadLeader.description: Gets leader UID for a squad. Use case: route leader-only commands.

SquadStateValue.description: Reads one shared squad state key. Use case: followers read current tactic.

ActiveTask.description: Current active task for one agent. Use case: show simple behavior labels above NPCs.

AlertLevel.description: Alert level value from trigger context. Use case: drive bar fill in a stealth meter.

AlertTierIndex.description: Numeric alert tier from trigger context. Use case: simple tier-based UI indicators.

AlertTierName.description: Named alert tier from trigger context. Use case: show readable debug text in HUD.

CompletedTask.description: Completed task ID from trigger context. Use case: reward points for finished objective tasks.

CurrentTask.description: Current started task ID. Use case: branch events by task name like patrol or chase.

EvaluateScorer.description: Returns scorer value for an agent now. Use case: graph utility output while balancing AI.

FailedCompoundTask.description: Compound task where planning failed. Use case: log broken network branches while testing.

FailedTask.description: Failed task ID from trigger context. Use case: retry or switch to a safer fallback action.

GlobalStateValue.description: Reads one shared global-state value. Use case: branch logic when global alarm is active.

InterruptedTask.description: Task that got interrupted. Use case: stop old animations cleanly before new behavior starts.

InterruptScore.description: Score that caused the last interruption. Use case: tune threshold to avoid over-reacting.

NewTask.description: New task after interruption. Use case: immediately start VFX for emergency reactions.

PlanLength.description: Remaining task count in the plan. Use case: detect when agents are close to idle.

PlanTaskAtIndex.description: Task ID at a plan index. Use case: preview next action for debugging UI.

PreviousTask.description: Previous task ID before current one. Use case: detect when behavior transitions happen.

PreviousTierIndex.description: Previous alert tier index. Use case: detect if alert increased or decreased.

RegisteredAgentType.description: Last registered agent type key. Use case: verify setup order in startup events.

StimulusIntensity.description: Stimulus intensity value. Use case: scale reaction speed by how strong the event was.

StimulusType.description: Stimulus type string from trigger context. Use case: react differently to sound vs visual cues.

StimulusX.description: Stimulus X coordinate. Use case: send NPC to investigate that position.

StimulusY.description: Stimulus Y coordinate. Use case: mark a noise location on minimap.

TriggerAgentUID.description: Agent UID from the latest trigger. Use case: pick the exact instance to move or animate.

WorldStateValue.description: Reads one world-state value for an agent. Use case: display health or awareness in UI.

CountAgents.description: Current registered agent count. Use case: monitor AI population for performance tuning.

CountRegisteredNetworks.description: How many task networks are loaded. Use case: quick startup validation in debug builds.

CountRegisteredScorers.description: How many utility scorers are loaded. Use case: confirm balance data loaded correctly.

CountRegisteredTasks.description: Number of primitive tasks for one type. Use case: verify network content during setup.

GetAgentUIDByIndex.description: Gets agent UID by list index. Use case: loop through all managed agents.

GetRegisteredTaskByIndex.description: Gets primitive task ID by index. Use case: print all registered tasks to a debug panel.
